content: Root cause: The performance regression in span queries was caused by the use of the TimSorter for sorting the `subSpansByDoc` array in the `NearSpansOrdered` class, which was likely inefficient in this context. The new implementation uses the `InPlaceMergeSorter`, which has lower overhead for sorting smaller arrays, thus significantly improving the performance.
